verdict.rationale: Bruno's docs say you can write docs alongside collections and publish them as shareable HTML (bruno-docs-20). This is backed by a rich-text docs editor (bruno-docs-12) and AI-assisted doc writing in the Docs tab (bruno-docs-53, bruno-docs-59). The publishing claim is a single marketing-level line, though, with no detail on how it works. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the HTML publish/export workflow and hosting options, evidence of generating docs from OpenAPI specs (not just collections), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
